scope: Profile cancellation during preparation preserves runtime and permission state
assertions: Cancellation in provider, identity, and permission preparation returns context.Canceled
Runtime fields, active profile, credential reference, authority pointer and service options remain unchanged
Permission commit never runs for cancelled operation
Fresh retry releases prior ownership and commits exactly once
limitations: Development targeted tests, not final candidate or full-suite evidence
Model switching has no cancellable context API; this regression covers SwitchProfileContext
No production change was needed for this cancellation boundary
